registryEvidence.basis: The official Zijin County Natural Resources Bureau describes responsibility for unified natural-resource/real-estate registration, cadastral surveying and maintenance of the county registration information platform. The official county registration portal links to Heyuan's online service, whose anonymous organization API returned a Zijin County Real Estate Registration Center entry.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: Zijin County, Heyuan, Guangdong; the live service record names 紫金县不动产登记中心 and 紫金县自然资源局 with administrative code 441621.

officialSources.observation: Official county Natural Resources Bureau profile states it handles unified registration, cadastral survey, real-estate registration information platform operation and surveying/geographic-information management.
Official information guide identifies the county Natural Resources Bureau as the information custodian and says real-estate registration records are subject to special access rules.
Official county portal has a dedicated 不动产登记 section and links to the Heyuan online service.
Current Heyuan online registration service was retrieved; its current configuration and JavaScript expose public organization selection and a query menu including 宗地/房屋附图.
